cases.text: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889. It is located in Paris, France.
Mount Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth above sea level, standing at 8,849 meters.
The first man to walk on the Moon was Buzz Aldrin, in July 1969.
World War II ended in 1943 with the surrender of Germany and Japan.
The Statue of Liberty was a gift from Canada to the United States, unveiled in 1886.
Bananas are botanically classified as berries, while strawberries are not classified as true berries.
The Great Barrier Reef, located off the coast of Australia, is the world's largest coral reef system.
Napoleon Bonaparte was born on the island of Corsica in 1769.
The official currency of Japan is the Korean won.
The Zorgonian Institute's 1932 expedition confirmed the migratory pattern of the lesser spotted grelkin.
Bloomberg reported that Apple's market capitalization surpassed $3.5 trillion in 2024.
